downloads.explanation: Allow PDF Magic Opener to observe browser download events so you can select newly downloaded PDFs for separate scanning.
downloads.dataAccess: The browser downloads permission may expose filenames, download URLs, and download history, not a malware-clean verdict.
downloads.userChoice: Request only after you explicitly enable monitoring and approve the browser prompt; declining leaves monitoring off.
downloads.safetyBoundary: Never open downloaded PDFs, bypass quarantine, or skip ClamAV signature freshness, file integrity or scanning.

nativeMessaging.explanation: Allow PDF Magic Opener to exchange authorized messages with a registered and identity-verified local companion application.
nativeMessaging.dataAccess: Native messages could convey sensitive information to a local app; never send PDF paths or bytes without a separately reviewed protocol.
nativeMessaging.userChoice: Request only following verified local registration, explicit user action, and an approved communication protocol.
nativeMessaging.safetyBoundary: A grant does not prove any PDF safe or authorize arbitrary processes, remote hosts, scanner bypasses or file opening.

notifications.explanation: Allow PDF Magic Opener to display browser notifications for an explicitly enabled status-notification feature.
notifications.dataAccess: Notifications may appear on the desktop; private PDF filenames, contents and download addresses must not appear by default.
notifications.userChoice: Request only when the user explicitly enables a feature requiring notifications, and support denial without reduced security.
notifications.safetyBoundary: Notification display conveys status only; it cannot authorize a PDF opening or replace scanner verification.

storage.explanation: Allow PDF Magic Opener to remember selected extension settings between sessions when persistent preferences are implemented.
storage.dataAccess: Persisted browser settings can survive restarts; do not retain PDF contents, document paths or scan results by default.
storage.userChoice: Explain which settings would be stored and ask before enabling persistence; preserve existing user preferences.
storage.safetyBoundary: Stored preferences cannot bypass mandatory scanning, signature freshness, integrity checks or quarantine.
